product_flow.name: Fishing rods and other line fishing tackle, fish landing nets, butterfly nets and similar nets, decoy "birds" and similar hunting or shooting requisites

required_qualifiers: actual site and reporting period
complete configured rod BOM and revision
non-telescopic carbon thermoset-epoxy structure and actual section/joint configuration
whole prepreg supplied state and supplier fibre/resin/finish boundary
whole guide and tip-top frames/rings supplied once
complete reel-seat hardware and no reel/line/hooks/baits supplied
actual EVA grip and butt closure inclusions
actual cutting/rolling/tape/cure/trim/sanding/coating/branding/assembly conditions
actual whole adhesive/coating/cleaning formulations and disjoint mixing subaccounts
manufacturer-required whole-rod inspections and acceptance/disposition
calibrated complete net rod mass and actual moisture/configuration
unique first-release cohort Q and release history
raw/WIP/non-WIP stores and complete per-exchange inherited vectors
released FG history and original service Q_c/H without new Q
full gross packaging P/I/ER/S/EO/W pools and upstream owner
actual assets/new and used repair parts/installed fluid and moisture bridges
actual utility supplier geography/voltage/delivery carrier and enthalpy
real molecular gas phases/sources/receiving media and actual waste outlets
complete native family restrictions in each selected card
unresolved identities/providers/quantities and uncertainty disclosed

product_flow.name: 钓竿及其他钓鱼用具，捕鱼网、捕蝶网及类似网，囮子及类似狩猎或射击用品

required_qualifiers: 真实场址及报告期
完整配置竿 BOM 及修订
非伸缩碳纤维热固环氧结构及真实竿节/接口配置
整份预浸料供货状态及供方纤维/树脂/整理边界
完整导环/顶环框架/环供货一次
完整轮座五金且无卷线器/鱼线/钩饵供货
真实 EVA 握柄/尾封包含项
真实裁/卷/缠带/固化/修整/打磨/涂层/标识/装配条件
真实整份胶/涂层/清洗配方及不重叠混配子账
制造商要求的整竿检查及放行/处置
经校准完整净竿质量及真实含水/配置
唯一首次放行 cohort Q 及放行历史
原料/在制/非在制储存及逐交换完整继承向量
已放行成品历史及不新增 Q 的原服务 Q_c/H
完整包装毛 P/I/ER/S/EO/W 池及上游 owner
真实资产/新旧维修件/在装流体与水分桥
真实公用工程供方地域/电压/交付载体与焓
真实分子气相/来源/接收介质及实际废物出口
每张选定卡中的完整原生家族限制
披露未解决身份/供方/数量及不确定性
